title: Answering one by one wastes too much time
subtitle: Duty shift in the od group
intro: Messages pop up one after another. Everyone thinks their question only costs him thirty seconds.
closing: Answering one by one wastes too much time. If there were a website, everyone could just look.

questions.text: Teacher, teacher, can you o on sertraline?

replies.label: No. Serotonin syndrome.
replies.reply: No. You can't o on sertraline; serotonin syndrome will make you wish you were dead.

replies.label: Ask a doctor.
replies.followUp: Xiaobei: If I had the money to see a doctor, would I be asking in this group?

questions.text: Can pregabalin and amantadine be taken together?

replies.label: Never combine them.
replies.reply: Never combine them. Don't treat someone else's experience as a prescription.

replies.label: I have never tried it.
replies.followUp: A-Lan: Then I'll ask someone else.

questions.text: Does memantine really leave holes in your brain?

replies.label: The risk is extremely high. It is not a brain supplement.
replies.reply: Gotō: The risk is extremely high. It is not a brain supplement.

replies.label: No, take it without worry.
replies.followUp: #4: Are you sure? My friend says it does.

replies.label: It depends on the dose.
replies.followUp: Group Member: Then how much is safe?

questions.interlude: Someone asks: teacher, what's your name? Gotō Hitori. So everyone starts calling him "Gotō".

replies.label: Don't. Serotonin syndrome.
replies.reply: Don't. Serotonin syndrome is not a joke.
replies.followUp: Xiaobei: Okay. I won't touch it.

replies.label: Ask someone else.
replies.followUp: Xiaobei: I was introduced here by someone else.

questions.text: I feel terrible. What do I do?

replies.label: Don't up the dose. Find someone you trust to stay with you.
replies.reply: Don't up the dose. Find someone you trust to stay with you; don't carry it alone.

replies.label: Take a little more and it'll be fine.
replies.reply: Take a little more and it'll be fine.

replies.label: Hold on a bit longer.
replies.followUp: Anonymous: I've been holding on for a long time already.
